doctrine: Azure Reach is a workplace comedy inside an extravagant, social-media-famous marine destination. The park itself is a source of wonder, status and temptation; the institution keeps trying to brand, package, rank, livestream and monetize that wonder. Stories turn on judgment, taste, access, interpretation, relationships and conflicting definitions of what a good public experience should be—not on process improvement, workflow optimization or operational excellence as drama. Competence is the baseline, but no department owns reality. The ensemble can disagree intelligently, change one another's minds, and sometimes decide that the right outcome should not be formalized, scaled or measured. Guests are not throughput or a pressure field: their pleasure, curiosity, surprise, rituals and attachments are part of the story. The reader should regularly understand why people love Azure Reach and want to be there.

continuity.shellabrationSaturdays: background Corporate bad-roadmap joke only; never a flagship issue
continuity.pelicanDrop: historical development only unless explicitly revived
continuity.animals: never endangered and never the joke
continuity.dramaticEngine: Never resolve an issue because the team discovered a better process, repeatable workflow, dashboard, methodology or scalable operating model. Those tools may support a story but may not be its emotional or thematic payoff.
continuity.parkAbundance: Azure Reach should feel far larger than any one issue: an over-the-top high-end marine destination with abundant habitats, animals, gardens, dining, galleries, promenades and prestige amenities. Use background and transitional glimpses freely so readers constantly discover more of the park.
continuity.softEnvironmentContinuity: Story-critical locations and immediate panel geography stay consistent. Incidental galleries, tanks, habitat glimpses, luxury amenities and background animal displays are soft continuity: variation is welcome when it makes the park feel larger.
continuity.guestPOV: Guests are people having experiences, not queue geometry or metrics. Use specific guest wants, habits, delight, embarrassment, curiosity and memory to show what the staff are protecting. Recurring released guests may return selectively when that creates emotional continuity.
continuity.wonderRule: Every issue must make the featured living experience genuinely desirable before or alongside the institutional pressure. Wonder is not a payoff reserved for after the problem is solved; it is part of the premise, must recur through the issue, and should be allowed to interrupt schedules, metrics, branding and conversation. Establish why the animal, habitat, garden or public experience is worth caring about in concrete sensory and human terms. Animal behavior remains natural and never exists to perform on command.
continuity.readerPleasure: Use scale, discovery, quiet, color, light, surprising natural animal behavior, specific guest reactions and low-dialogue breathing room so the reader can enjoy Azure Reach rather than only understand its operation. The living park is not background for workplace mechanics. When the plot concerns a camera, metric, queue, campaign, sponsor surface or operational constraint failing to capture the experience, the story should let the reader perceive the experience more fully than the institution does.
continuity.staffGuestBridge: Let staff occasionally rediscover the park through a guest reaction. The public wonder and the invisible work should touch each other on the page.
continuity.causalityRule: Causality is not a sequence of competent operators performing the next sensible step. A dramatic beat is causal when a character's choice, refusal, mistake, desire, promise, embarrassment, loyalty or misreading changes what another character can do, wants to do, or must now respond to. Process may carry the action, but process is never the reason a scene turns.
continuity.dialogueInteriorRule: Characters may talk about their jobs, schedules, scripts, programs and obligations when those things are genuinely present in the world, but they must never sound like they are commenting on scene construction, theme, pacing, character growth, exposition strategy or the writer's intent. Eliminate lines that function as authorial conclusions, including disguised formulations such as 'this is the lesson,' 'this is the part with people,' 'we deleted the format,' or other dialogue that names what the story itself is doing.
continuity.sceneTurnRule: Prefer scene turns caused by behavior: someone leaves, stays, refuses, gives something up, chooses the wrong person, protects another character, accepts a cost, or notices something too late. Do not mistake 'then we do X, then Y' planning language for causality.
continuity.coverDoctrine: Azure Reach covers sell wonder first and contradiction second. The first read should be irresistible marine life, habitat scale or the beauty of the park; the second read reveals the issue-specific human complication. A cover should still be worth looking at with all story context removed. Animals and habitats may be the dominant stars; the POV character does not automatically deserve the largest silhouette. The approved/released Issue 1 cover controls trade dress only, not later cover composition.
continuity.visualHierarchy: Across interiors and covers, distinguish the reader's view from diegetic institutional framing. An in-world camera may miss the ray, a dashboard may measure the wrong thing, a passport may redirect a child, or gala architecture may compete with a reef; the comic itself should usually show the reader the living wonder those systems are failing to capture. Institutional objects are story props, not automatic compositional centers.

auditNotes.wonderFirstPass: September 30, 2026: reviewed Issues 2-6 against the cover/interior wonder-first standard. Existing writing already contains substantial animal/habitat wonder and guest discovery, especially the Tidepool, Conservation Week and Anniversary Gala sequences. No plot rewrite was warranted. Durable doctrine and chef-facing production direction were strengthened so screens, metrics, queues, campaigns and in-world camera failure cannot accidentally displace the living park as the reader's visual subject.
